description: Land Acquisition - Aluthwewa & Aadagala, Galewela D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired, including lot numbers, extents, boundaries, and locations. While it mentions a government minister (Gayantha Karunatilleke) and his title, this is incidental to the main purpose of the document, which is the legal acquisition of land properties. The content fits squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it concerns "land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" and "land registrations, property ownership, land titles."
